_comment: Vesilabra (games/vesilabra): spoken goals, lessons and hints; written by tools/vesilabra/voice.js from the game's TEXT table. The Finnish ones are in voice/fi.json.

clips.vl_leikki: Sandbox! Hold your finger on the screen to pour water or sand. Tap a valve to open it.
clips.vl_1: Open the red valve so the water reaches the tank.
clips.vl_2: Tap the pipes to turn them so the water reaches the tank.
clips.vl_3: Water turns the wheel. Turn the pipe so the water falls on the right side of the wheel. Then the wheel turns the right way and lifts the gate.
clips.vl_4: Fill both vessels to the line. The tap is at the top and the valve at the bottom.
clips.vl_5: Fill the vessels to different lines. The middle valve keeps them apart.
clips.vl_6: The water escapes into the pit. Fill it with sand so the water reaches the tank.
clips.vl_1_opi: Water flows down because gravity pulls it.
clips.vl_2_opi: Water only follows the pipes when they are connected.
clips.vl_3_opi: Flowing water does work: it turns a water wheel.
clips.vl_4_opi: In connected vessels the water stands at the same height.
clips.vl_5_opi: A closed valve breaks the connection, and the levels can differ.
clips.vl_6_opi: Wet sand holds water back, but a sieve lets water through.
clips.vl_h_putki: Tap the pipe where the finger is. It turns.
clips.vl_h_hyrra: Tap the pipe so the water falls on the right side of the wheel.
clips.vl_h_vaarin: The wheel turns the wrong way! Turn the pipe the other way.
clips.vl_h_hana: Tap the tap to let the water run.
clips.vl_h_hana_kiinni: That's enough! Tap the tap to stop the water.
clips.vl_h_auki: Open the middle valve so the water gets into the other vessel.
clips.vl_h_kiinni: Close the middle valve to keep the vessels apart.
clips.vl_h_pois: Too much water! Open the valve in the left vessel's bottom to let some out.
clips.vl_h_pois_kiinni: Close the valve in the left vessel's bottom.
clips.vl_h_hiekka: Choose the sand at the bottom.
clips.vl_h_kuoppa: Pour sand into the pit with your finger.
clips.vl_h_loppu: The sand ran out. Start again.
clips.vl_h_odota: Good! Wait a moment, the water is flowing.
